能顺便加饷吗？: Does this come with a raise?
盾卫的盾比门板还大，据说有人拿它当过雪橇。他们最大的爱好是站着不动，最大的烦恼是: A guard's shield is bigger than a door, and someone once used one as a sled. Their favorite hobby is standing still. Their biggest worry is archers hiding behind them.
弓手个个自称百步穿杨，实际上是八十步。不过他们跑得快，躲得更快，这也是一种本事。: Every archer claims to hit a target at a hundred paces. It is more like eighty. But they run fast and hide faster, and that counts as a skill.
法师的帽子是向一位退休大法师赊的，到现在还没还。每次施法前都要先扶一下帽子，和: The mage's hat was borrowed from a retired archmage and never returned. Every spell starts with straightening it, a lot like Kael and his helmet.
书上说，这招会炸: The book says it goes boom.
牧师随身带着一壶永远温热的蜂蜜茶，据说比任何咒语都灵。她最常说的一句话是：\"先: The cleric carries a flask of honey tea that never goes cold, said to beat any spell. Her most common sentence is "Sit down and don't move."
骑士的马比骑士更有主见。冲锋的方向，通常是马选的。: The knight's horse has more opinions than the knight does. The charge direction is usually the horse's call.
哟，小射手！听说你把果冻王子请回家了？我是佣兵团的团长，Brann。: Well, if it isn't the little archer! I hear you sent Prince Jelly home. I'm Brann, captain of the mercenary company.
团长好！呃……你的胡子里是不是有只鸟？: Hello, Captain! Um... is there a bird in your beard?
那是我的账房。它负责盯着我，别把军饷花在奇怪的地方。: That's my accountant. Its job is to make sure I don't spend the pay on silly things.
规矩简单：你击败怪物攒军饷，军饷够了，我的兵就上。兵营在商店里，最多带三个兵种。: Simple rules: beat monsters, save up pay, and when there's enough, my people show up. Pick your crew at the Barracks in the shop, three kinds at most.
好！请多关照……哎呀，头盔又滑下来了。: Deal! Pleased to work with you... oops, my helmet slipped again.
放心，天塌下来，我的兵替你扶着。: Don't worry. If the sky falls, my people will hold your helmet.
佣兵团长 Brann 带着他的兵来了。他胡子里住着一只叫\"账房\"的小鸟。他说: Captain Brann and his mercenaries have arrived. A little bird called "Accountant" lives in his beard. He says as long as the wall stands, nobody goes unpaid.
新兵到了！盾卫的盾比门板还大，怪物冲上来，先撞他，不撞你。: New recruits! The guards carry shields bigger than doors. When monsters rush in, they hit the guard first, not you.
好稳啊……我的头盔要是也这么稳就好了。: So steady... I wish my helmet were that steady.
盾卫入伍了。团长说他们的盾比门板还大，我的头盔却还是不太稳。: The guards have enlisted. The captain says their shields are bigger than doors. My helmet is still not very steady.
弓手们到啦。别问他们准不准，问就是\"风向不对\"。: The archers are here. Don't ask if they're accurate. The answer is always "wrong wind."
我也是弓手！那我也能说\"风向不对\"吗？: I'm an archer too! Can I say "wrong wind" as well?
弓手入伍了。他们说百步穿杨，团长说那是八十步。: The archers have enlisted. They say a hundred paces; the captain says it's eighty.
法师来了。千万别碰他的帽子，他说里面装着一整座图书馆。: The mages have arrived. Whatever you do, don't touch the hat. He says there's a whole library inside.
那比我的头盔厉害多了，我的里面只有头发。: That beats my helmet by a mile. Mine only has hair in it.
法师入伍了。他的帽子里据说有一座图书馆，我的头盔里只有头发。: The mages have enlisted. His hat supposedly holds a library. My helmet only holds hair.
牧师随队了。受了伤别硬撑，她那壶蜂蜜茶，比什么咒语都灵。: The clerics have joined us. If you're hurt, don't tough it out. Her honey tea works better than any spell.
我可以只喝茶，不受伤吗？: Can I just have the tea, without the getting hurt?
牧师入伍了。她的蜂蜜茶永远是热的，我想试试，但不想先受伤。: The clerics have enlisted. Her honey tea is always warm. I'd like to try it, just not after getting hurt.

那我们是不是该给马也发一份饷？: Then shouldn't the horses get paid, too?
骑士入伍了。团长说马比骑士更有主见，所以饷要发两份。: The knights have enlisted. The captain says the horses have more opinions than the riders, so the pay is doubled.
